title: Washer, Dryer, Folder
statementMd:
You have $*k*$ pieces of laundry, each of which you want to wash, dry and fold. You are at a laundromat that has $*n*_{1}$ washing machines, $*n*_{2}$ drying machines and $*n*_{3}$ folding machines. Each machine can process only one piece of laundry at a time. You can't dry a piece of laundry before it is washed, and you can't fold it before it is dried. Moreover, after a piece of laundry is washed, it needs to be immediately moved into a drying machine, and after it is dried, it needs to be immediately moved into a folding machine.

It takes $*t*_{1}$ minutes to wash one piece of laundry in a washing machine, $*t*_{2}$ minutes to dry it in a drying machine, and $*t*_{3}$ minutes to fold it in a folding machine. Find the smallest number of minutes that is enough to wash, dry and fold all the laundry you have.

## Input

The only line of the input contains seven integers: $*k*, *n*_{1}, *n*_{2}, *n*_{3}, *t*_{1}, *t*_{2}, *t*_{3}$ $(1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{4}; 1 ≤ *n*_{1}, *n*_{2}, *n*_{3}, *t*_{1}, *t*_{2}, *t*_{3} ≤ 1000)$.

## Output

Print one integer — smallest number of minutes to do all your laundry.

## Note

In the first example there's one instance of each machine, each taking 5 minutes to complete. You have only one piece of laundry, so it takes 15 minutes to process it.

In the second example you start washing first two pieces at moment $0$. If you start the third piece of laundry immediately, then by the time it is dried, there will be no folding machine available, so you have to wait, and start washing third piece at moment $2$. Similarly, you can't start washing next piece until moment $5$, since otherwise there will be no dryer available, when it is washed. Start time for each of the eight pieces of laundry is $0, 0, 2, 5, 10, 10, 12$ and $15$ minutes respectively. The last piece of laundry will be ready after $15 + 10 + 5 + 2 = 32$ minutes.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

你有 $*k*$ 件衣物，需要将每件衣物洗涤、烘干并折叠。你所在的洗衣店有 $*n*_{1}$ 台洗衣机、$*n*_{2}$ 台烘干机和 $*n*_{3}$ 台折叠机。每台机器一次只能处理一件衣物。衣物必须先洗涤后才能烘干，并且必须先烘干后才能折叠。此外，衣物洗涤完成后，需要立即将其移入一台烘干机；烘干完成后，也需要立即将其移入一台折叠机。

在洗衣机中洗涤一件衣物需要 $*t*_{1}$ 分钟，在烘干机中烘干需要 $*t*_{2}$ 分钟，在折叠机中折叠需要 $*t*_{3}$ 分钟。请找出足以将所有衣物洗涤、烘干并折叠完成的最少时间。

## 输入格式

输入仅一行，包含七个整数：$*k*, *n*_{1}, *n*_{2}, *n*_{3}, *t*_{1}, *t*_{2}, *t*_{3}$ $(1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{4}; 1 ≤ *n*_{1}, *n*_{2}, *n*_{3}, *t*_{1}, *t*_{2}, *t*_{3} ≤ 1000)$。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即完成所有衣物所需的最少分钟数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，每种机器各有一台，且每台机器完成一件衣物都需要 5 分钟。你只有一件衣物，因此处理它需要 15 分钟。

在第二个样例中，你在时刻 $0$ 开始洗涤前两件衣物。如果立即开始洗涤第三件衣物，那么等它烘干完成时将没有可用的折叠机，因此你必须等待，并在时刻 $2$ 开始洗涤第三件衣物。同样地，在时刻 $5$ 之前你不能开始洗涤下一件衣物，否则它洗涤完成时将没有可用的烘干机。八件衣物的开始洗涤时间分别为 $0, 0, 2, 5, 10, 10, 12$ 和 $15$ 分钟。最后一件衣物将在 $15 + 10 + 5 + 2 = 32$ 分钟后完成。
